20261122-chemistry-g04-2.material: [E4 Investigasaun Kímika (Avansadu)] Problema análize kuantitativu kona-ba Mudansa estadu bee. Solusaun ásida $A$ iha $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ no solusaun $B$ iha $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Konsentrasaun iñaun idrojéniu iha $A$ boot liu fali iha $B$ dala hira?
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.prompt: [E4 Investigasaun Kímika (Avansadu)] Problema análize kuantitativu kona-ba Mudansa estadu bee. Solusaun ásida $A$ iha $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ no solusaun $B$ iha $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Konsentrasaun iñaun idrojéniu iha $A$ boot liu fali iha $B$ dala hira?
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.s.s1.explain:
Pasu 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Pasu 2: Rásiu $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Pasu 3: Konsentrasaun $A$ boot liu $B$ dala 100.
